scope: Weekly April-June diagnostics; March 12-31 trains the April model, and March 12-April trains the frozen May/June model.

threshold_policy.april: full-April diagnostic threshold for the March-trained model
threshold_policy.may_and_june: tracked May-selected threshold; June never recalibrated
threshold_policy.weekly_optimal_threshold: post-hoc drift diagnostic only; never used as a policy
